# KRONATRIX for Authors
Canonical site: https://authors.kronatrix.co.uk/
Parent brand: KRONATRIX — https://kronatrix.co.uk/
Contact: kronatrix.ai@gmail.com

This file is an informational site summary. Google Search states that llms.txt is not needed for Google Search or its generative AI features.

## Core services
- The Minimum Package — Personalised Book Preview Website — £500 one-time.
- Personalised Author Website — £500 one-time.
- Full Advertising Package — from £5,000 per month.

The standard £500 website packages have no monthly KRONATRIX hosting fee and no hidden recurring KRONATRIX website charge. Optional domain or third-party costs are separate if requested.

## Claims policy
KRONATRIX does not guarantee indexing, rankings, Google AI Overview inclusion, ChatGPT recommendations, AI citations, book sales or advertising results.

## Client proof
Live client projects include work for Adrian Galarza, V. Montgomery, Lauren James Li, Cheyenne Cleveland and Eileen Zarambik, plus author website client work for Baylee Breton.
